services.heading: How it works
services.sub: Three steps from a paid package to Seller-Center-visible attributed sales.

steps.title: Choose and pay for a package
steps.text: Select the appropriate video package. Hammad Media LLC issues the invoice, paid 100% upfront. We confirm the product, category, account allocation, and production schedule in writing.

steps.title: Prepare for production
steps.text: Ship the product from your US inventory, activate the agreed TikTok Shop commission, and provide any key product information, compliance requirements, and restricted claims.

steps.title: Creator-led production and measurable sales
steps.text: I write, film, and appear in the content. Editing follows my direction and established production standards. Videos are posted according to the agreed schedule, and attributed sales remain visible in your TikTok Shop Seller Center.

exclusivity.name: Category exclusivity
exclusivity.price: $50,000 per 30-day period · per precisely defined product category · paid upfront · no videos included
facts: subject to category availability and a written agreement
exclusivity.text: Category exclusivity reserves one precisely defined product category for a paid 30-day period. During that period, I do not publish new affiliate content for the specifically agreed competing products within the invoiced category. Prior content remains live, and TikTok's continued distribution of older videos is unchanged. Exact competitors, dates, posting restrictions, and usage terms are defined in the written agreement.

contact.heading: Work with me
contact.subheading: Tell me about your product: your TikTok Shop link, your category, and the commission you can offer. I accept a limited number of new paid campaigns each month. I reply to every brand inquiry within 24 hours. You work directly with Hammad Media's creator-led team without agency account-manager layers. If your product fits, the next step is a short call. On the call, I show you my live sales dashboards.

faq.heading: Questions brands ask

items.q: How fast is the first video?
items.a: After payment is confirmed, the product is in hand, TikTok Shop commission is active, and the campaign is scheduled, the first-video timing is confirmed in writing.
It depends on your product price and your profit margin.
bullets: Most products I accept pay **20–35%** commission on TikTok Shop
Higher rates get priority in my posting schedule
Performance bonuses move you to the top of the list for your category

items.a: **Yes to talking points. No to routine approvals.** Send me your key points. I will read every word. Creator-led production: no routine draft approvals, revision rounds, or reshoots unless expressly agreed in writing. The video goes straight from my camera to my audience unless we have agreed otherwise in writing. Here is why: when brands edit videos, the videos feel like ads. Ads do not sell on TikTok Shop. Every number on this page comes from working this way.

Every package is paid 100% upfront and includes TikTok Shop commission, so commission remains aligned to performance. I do not stop after one video. I test different openings and styles. Some products need three videos before one becomes a top seller. My biggest winner took more than 200 videos across two years. If a product does not fit my audience, I will tell you directly. That saves time for both of us.
Pricing is by package, **paid 100% upfront**, plus TikTok Shop commission. We agree on the video count before we start:
bullets: 100% upfront + TikTok Shop commission. Month to month — no long-term contract.

items.q: What does a video package include?
items.a: Your package buys a **set number of review videos**. We agree on the count before we start. I post them on both accounts, on the agreed schedule.
bullets: You check every attributed sale in your own TikTok Shop Seller Center
Invoices come from **Hammad Media LLC**, a registered US company
Month to month — you can stop after one month

items.a: Category exclusivity reserves one **precisely defined product category** for a paid **30-day period**. **$50,000** per 30-day period, **paid upfront**. No videos are included — video packages are purchased separately. Subject to category availability and a written agreement.
bullets: **Per category, not the whole vertical** — you reserve a precisely defined product category, such as collagen.

During that period, I do not publish new affiliate content for the specifically agreed competing products within the invoiced category. Prior content remains live, and TikTok's continued distribution of older videos is unchanged.
Exact competitors, dates, posting restrictions, and usage terms are defined in the written agreement.

items.q: Can we run your videos as ads?
items.a: Spark authorization is available only for the specific videos, TikTok accounts, duration, commission terms, and usage rights stated in the written offer. It is not included unless expressly agreed. If ad usage matters to you, say so in your inquiry.

items.q: Our team is not based in the US — can we still work together?
items.a: Yes. Many of my partners run TikTok Shop US from outside the US. The process is simple. You ship the sample from your US warehouse. We agree on terms over email. For paid campaigns, Hammad Media LLC invoices 100% upfront. Payment can be bank transfer or PayPal invoice. TikTok Shop separately pays the agreed sales commission automatically.

faq.sub: Clear answers. The same answers I give on every call.
